liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **ripple** (1 review): The listener felt Ripple as the closing number suited the night perfectly [7]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): John Mayer sounded especially good on this song, according to the reviewer [9]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer was glad it closed the first set [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **pitb**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [11]
- **aiko**: back after 103 archived shows (1380 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [11]
- **hurtsme2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **ramble**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **bew**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **grow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **darkstr**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **elpaso**: back after 34 archived shows (793 days) [11]

## The recordings

- **deadco2021-09-02.153210.zoom.nick.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 193 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Opening Wheel sounds a bit shaky, but quality improves by Playing in the Band and stays good to the end [1]
- **deadco2021-09-02.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 193 min [2]
- **dac2021-09-02.mbhoka200.akgck63.v3.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 193 min [3]
- **deadco2021-09-02.XfinityCenterMansfiledMASennheisers**: audience recording; 17 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Lineup listed: Bob Weir on guitar and vocals, John Mayer on guitar and vocals, Oteil Burbridge on bass and vocals [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2021-09-02.153210.zoom.nick.flac16**: source: Zoom H3-VR Ambisonic recorder > Ambisonic A format @ 24b/44.1k [1]. Also: Taped from section 6, dead front and center behind the board, on a Zoom H3-VR ambisonic recorder, converted via Audacity and TLH [1]
- **deadco2021-09-02.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHOka200n(ortf)->V3(24/48)->Tascam DR680) [2]. Also: Recorded by Bob Crupi with microphones at seven feet, clamped to the back-of-house rail, dead front center, section 6; Transfer went from SDEC10 through Sound Forge 11 for tracking and fades, then TLH to FLAC level 8 [2]
- **dac2021-09-02.mbhoka200.akgck63.v3.flac16**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHOka200n(ortf)->V3(24/48)->Tascam DR680 + AKGck63/Nbob actives/Naiant pfa's(dina)->Tascam DR680 (Busman Mod) [3]. Also: Bob Crupi recorded with MBHO ORTF mics plus AKG CK63 into a Tascam DR680, positioned at the back-of-house rail; Transferred with Sonar and Sound Forge 11 using MBIT+ dither and resampling, then TLH FLAC at level 8 [3]
- **deadco2021-09-02.XfinityCenterMansfiledMASennheisers**: taped by W Zimmerman; transferred by JT/NY; source: BOB > Aud > Sennheiser Me-80 Mini Shotguns> GakCables > Mix Pre 6 @ 16/48 [4]. Also: Audience recording with Sennheiser ME-80 mini shotguns into a Mix Pre 6, edited in Sound Forge Pro 13, converted with TLH [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Dead And Company Poster Xfinity Center, Mansfield, MA 9/2&9/3/2021 Zeb Love | #4853861592](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/dead-company-poster-xfinity-center-4853861592) [12]
